cases.buyer_trigger: UK/EU Etsy micro-seller / poor listing search reach
cases.purchased_job: Independent professional optimization of Etsy listing titles, 13 tags and keyword selection
cases.money_observed: Fiverr buyer reviews from UK in 2026 show up-to-$50 paid range; seller had 260+ reviews
cases.capture_evidence: UK individual explicitly reports paid service and rates communication; buyer was still awaiting traffic results, so no observed sales uplift
cases.complete_output: Product listing link, niche and competitors -> Etsy-ready optimized 13 tags/titles plus evidence rationale
cases.verification: 13 tags and max lengths deterministic; actual Etsy ranking/revenue cannot be guaranteed or objectively certified
cases.repeat_AI: AI can regenerate keywords/tags; high-relevance tradeoff and current algorithm uncertainty remains
cases.AI_build: AI-built keyword research/generation is already in Alura, eRank and competing freelancers
cases.first_ten_route: Etsy UK shop directories, first ten specific buy intent not verified
cases.second_kill: The customer buys under-$50 personal review and confidence, not a proven system-owned sales outcome; ongoing algorithm changes and incumbent competitors
cases.next_attack: No new keyword-generator SaaS without repeat buyer choice over Alura and freelancers

cases.buyer_trigger: UK independent dressmaking hobbyist / custom garment sketch
cases.purchased_job: Pattern cutter drafts printable sewing pieces and optionally grades sizes
cases.money_observed: UK fixed guide £60 for simple top, £90 for shirt; grading £15–£30 per size
cases.capture_evidence: Standalone digital pattern production is offered, but no independently evidenced paid buyer in this source
cases.complete_output: Measurements and garment style -> PDF/A0 pattern with labeled cut/seam lines and graded sizes
cases.verification: Geometry and seam-length checks possible; fit and drape need real toile and human judgment
cases.repeat_AI: Standard garment templates work with size inputs; unusual pattern choices and fit require iterations
cases.AI_build: A new pattern generator clones established Sewist/Tailornova features while human errors cause returned garments
cases.first_ten_route: UK sewing-pattern businesses, no named ten first buyers who cannot use existing generators
cases.second_kill: Technically digitizable standard styles do not carry bespoke patternmaker's understanding and sample-fit responsibility
cases.next_attack: No separate paid recurring software demand

cases.buyer_trigger: UK independent video producer / foreign-language delivery window accelerated
cases.purchased_job: Native-speaker timed translated subtitle file package delivered 24–48h rather than 2–3 business days
cases.money_observed: Subtitling £8–£15/video min plus explicit +50% rush surcharge
cases.capture_evidence: Offered rush on full validated captions; no direct buyer order for premium documented
cases.complete_output: Provided licensed video/audio -> professionally timed translated SRT/VTT/broadcast deliverables
cases.verification: CPS/line limits, timing and file parse verifiable; linguistic correctness culturally depends on native reviewer
cases.repeat_AI: Models do fast transcript/translation and timestamping, but final native-language review remains
cases.AI_build: Caption SaaS and vendor APIs already offer fast full drafts; separate vendor has no advantage over incumbent
cases.first_ten_route: UK production houses directories, 10 timed buyers not verified
cases.second_kill: +50% buys reserved linguist and guaranteed human QC, same exact provider's existing rush tier
cases.next_attack: Do not reclassify human bilingual proofing premium as AI markup

cases.buyer_trigger: UK solicitor/immigration applicant / court or visa deadline in an hour
cases.purchased_job: Fast certified translation delivered within 1 hour vs 24-hour tier
cases.money_observed: 1h from £0.22/source word vs 24h £0.12; £45 order minimum; variable language coverage
cases.capture_evidence: Premium is linguist roster and signed validation/certification, not software delivery speed
cases.complete_output: Uploaded source contract/certificate -> accepted signed translation with professional accountability
cases.verification: Word count and glossary can verify; translation and signatory authority not automated
cases.repeat_AI: AI generates fast translation but cannot sign independent accuracy certificate accepted by authority
cases.AI_build: Build trivial draft translation system; licensed human professional signoff still needed every submission
cases.first_ten_route: UK regulated translation buyers reachable, acceptance and authority risk high
cases.second_kill: Professional certification/trust is the very premium; automated translation alone not sold outcome
cases.next_attack: No product built to sell legally accepted human certifications

cases.buyer_trigger: UK independent author releasing fantasy book with art deadline
cases.purchased_job: Seven-day rush hand-illustrated book-cover design instead of regular queue
cases.money_observed: £200 rush surcharge on top of £800 ebook or £1,000 full-cover design
cases.capture_evidence: Provider explicitly promises original non-AI licensed illustration; customer purchases human IP assurance and expedited artist time
cases.complete_output: Book genre and premise -> copyrightable original print-ready cover accepted by author
cases.verification: Print bleed/spine format testable, artistic originality and effective genre positioning subjective
cases.repeat_AI: Image AI creates candidates but cannot guarantee original copyrightable human work
cases.AI_build: AI-built design generator is a different lower-trust product, not £200 express original-art fee
cases.first_ten_route: UK indie writers groups, book designers; no named buyers switching
cases.second_kill: Premium buys scarce human illustration labour; unrelated to fast model sampling
cases.next_attack: No safe software substitution for this differentiated service

cases.buyer_trigger: UK corporate podcaster / scheduled sponsor episode releasing tomorrow
cases.purchased_job: Editing/mixing raw podcast 24-hour rush vs standard two-day package
cases.money_observed: Zinn Hub advertises +£100 rush upgrade in GBP, base marketplace listing from $24 with varying packages
cases.capture_evidence: Rush tier sold as independent add-on, actual paid rush orders not separately verified
cases.complete_output: Licensed multitrack audio + notes -> delivered mixed normalized file with timed edits and sponsor inserts
cases.verification: Audio peak/loudness measurable but editorial cuts and filler selection subjective
cases.repeat_AI: Automatic transcription/filler cleanup easily repeated; complex host-specific editorial judgement requires manual
cases.AI_build: Several complete AI-first podcast editors exist; live editor's rapid personal attention is premium
cases.first_ten_route: UK podcast production companies and creators; no ten recurrent buyer commitments
cases.second_kill: Very expensive rush upgrade likely buys guaranteed human reserved editing queue; no separate entrant budget proven

cases.buyer_trigger: UK embroidery shop owner / need stitched logo for imminent garment batch
cases.purchased_job: Image/logo-to-machine DST/PES/JEF embroidery file in 2–4h vs 4–8h
cases.capture_evidence: Complete downloadable machine file offered with priority tier, but customer likely paying tiny one-time amount
cases.complete_output: Source logo+garment weave+dimensions -> machine stitch program with simulation and accepted test
cases.verification: Stitch length, thread changes, machine format parse checkable; actual stitch-out quality physical
cases.repeat_AI: General AI can prepare motifs but fabric-dependent density and underlay are engineering decisions
cases.AI_build: Free Ink/Stitch and machine vendor suites handle conversions; remaining design is human digitizer QA
cases.first_ten_route: UK embroidery and uniform print shops findable, no ten switchers
cases.second_kill: A £7.50 minimum rush premium cannot fund acquisition or physical quality assurance

cases.buyer_trigger: UK signage shop / last-minute scalable vector logo for cutter
cases.purchased_job: Source image redrawn into clean spot-color vinyl-ready vector, rushed 2–4h instead of 4–8h
cases.capture_evidence: Separately bought output is digitized path-art, but price and exact complete provider commoditize the work
cases.complete_output: JPG/PNG logo -> correct SVG/EPS/AI closed cutter paths and separable spot colors
cases.verification: Closed contours, zero self-intersections and color separations checkable; exact typography/manual trace subjective
cases.repeat_AI: Auto-trace and LLM-powered vectorization produce most straightforward logos in minutes
cases.AI_build: Illustrator and Inkscape already do auto-trace, plus cheap human fallback
cases.first_ten_route: UK signmakers/printshops directories, no ten buyer selection reason
cases.second_kill: Tiny premium buys fast human cleanup of ambiguous brand shapes; incumbent already serves same checkout

cases.buyer_trigger: UK best man/father of bride / imminent speech deadline
cases.purchased_job: Bespoke professionally written and edited wedding toast in 48h rather than normal package
cases.money_observed: £545 urgent speech vs £445 standard, explicit £100 premium
cases.capture_evidence: A different buyer/trigger/outcome from #805 couple wedding vows: wedding-party speaker pays for urgent personalized toast and coaching, not only wording draft
cases.complete_output: Private interview and stories -> socially appropriate speech with revisions and delivery coaching
cases.verification: Emotional style and family-context appropriateness no deterministic oracle
cases.repeat_AI: Same provider already provides £49 AI alternative producing speech in one hour, demonstrating AI price ceiling
cases.AI_build: AI speech app trivial to replicate and provider itself owns both human and AI lanes
cases.first_ten_route: UK wedding speakers reachable but very irregular one-off purchases
cases.second_kill: Human reassurance, editing and deadline access attach premium, not generic completion

cases.buyer_trigger: UK individual buying handmade digital caricature gift urgently
cases.purchased_job: Customized hand-drawn digital caricature delivered in 24h rather than standard 5+ days
cases.money_observed: Additional £39 24h charge vs £9 2–4 days or zero priority charge standard
cases.capture_evidence: File-only output genuinely digital and paid rush exists as vendor offer; no independent buyer-paid rush evidence
cases.complete_output: Customer-owned photos and desired scene -> bespoke caricature image, digital file approved by recipient
cases.verification: Resolution/file criteria trivial; recognizable likeness and artistic expression subjective
cases.repeat_AI: AI portrait models deliver immediate stylizations at near-zero time, not hand-drawn personal art
cases.AI_build: AI-built style filter does not replace boutique artist; target price low and emotional revision work high
cases.first_ten_route: UK gift buyers/public directory, one-off and no recurring route
cases.second_kill: Website has stale Christmas 2024 notice and rush value entirely tied to human queue/talent; price may be dated
cases.next_attack: Do not imply active urgency purchase from stale marketing

research_note: Prosumer cases 808-809; explicit paid deadline premium cases 810-817. Published fees not proof actual purchase of rush tier. Marketplace UK reviews count as buyer-observed evidence only for their exact orders. Certain vendor marketing pages may be stale; unverified buyer demand never promoted.
